notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Planning workflow: read-only exploration, dependency graph, vertical slicing, tasks with acceptance criteria and verification, sizing rules, checkpoints, and a plan document template; output is tasks/plan.md plus a task list (default tasks/todo.md).

Writes tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md in the user's repo, with an explicit rule never to overwrite an incomplete plan for different work without asking (SKILL.md:150-155). Rated medium because when the project's agent rules or the user designate an external tracker (GitHub Issues, Jira, Linear, beads), it has the agent create one tracker item per task (SKILL.md:162), a state-changing operation on a live service using the user's existing tracker access. Acceptable because the tracker is the user's own, it is used only when the user or project rules designate it, and the skill forbids bulk-closing or deleting other plans' items (SKILL.md:155). This is not feedback/telemetry to a third party.

SKILL.md:257 points to ../../references/definition-of-done.md, outside the skill directory and not shipped; it is a 'See Also' pointer, so the skill works without it. SKILL.md:161 mentions a /build command and downstream tooling from the upstream collection that are not bundled. The 'injection-like phrase' signal appears to be the 'Do NOT write code during planning' / 'stop and ask' guidance, which constrains rather than overrides the agent.
